lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular geometric grid; the mid-flank region displays approximately 5-6 distinct columns of spots aligned vertically posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the circular centroids of the lateral spots, forming a grid-like lattice or checkerboard topology across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient (high luminance on the superior edge, shadow on the inferior edge).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a high density of small, high-luminance spots distributed across its visible surface, appearing more clustered and smaller in radius than the primary flank blobs.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small yellow teleost fish (likely pilot fish) clustered around the leading edge and ventral surface of the pectoral fin.
